items.title: 70399_Theodore _Red_ Saunders oral history interview
items.q: [INTERVIEWER] Yeah. And then when he left her, Johnny Collins, -- [INTERVIEWEE] Yeah, Collins.

ctx.x: Right, right, right, right. And then, like I told you about the baseball games, they used to get out in the park, come out there and play baseball. And I mean, it was just that type of a thing. But somewhere down the line, somebody had to take care of business. So Lil was the one that did it. She took care of business and he helped teach him to read and all of that, because he was as blind as a bat.
Yeah. And then when he left her, Johnny Collins, --
